newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Alpha-Beta slips.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Alpha-Beta slips.

text.p: Alpha-Beta Technology Inc shares fell in pre-opening trading after it said that its Betafectin showed no statistical significance in a test to see if it could cut serious infections.
Shares were trading down to 7-1/2, traders said, down from a closing price on Friday of 10-13/16.
The drug cut infection in one stratum of patients, those undergoing non-colorectal gastointestinal surgeries, but not in the overall study.

In the overall study, 17 percent of the patients treated with Betafectin suffered serious post-surgical infections compared with 21 percent of the placebo patients, which is not statistically significant.
Intel was trading slightly lower, at 92-7/8 from a closing price of 93-10/16, traders said.
Motorola and IBM said on Monday they would introduce three PowerPC microprocessors.
Overall, traders said the pre-opening session was quiet.
